b1-monarchia-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Dual System
b1-monarchia-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview the examiner asks what the dual system meant for Hungary.
b1-monarchia-01.prompt: Tell the examiner that, on the one hand, Hungary had its own government and, on the other hand, the army was common.
cues: Say what Hungary had on the one hand
Say what was common on the other hand
b1-monarchia-01.target: Egyrészt Magyarországnak saját kormánya volt, másrészt a hadsereg közös volt.
b1-monarchia-01.english: On the one hand Hungary had its own government; on the other hand the army was common.
b1-monarchia-01.canDo: I can explain how the dual system divided power between Vienna and Budapest.

b1-monarchia-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Heroes' Square
b1-monarchia-02.scenario: You walk across Heroes' Square with a friend who asks what the monument commemorates and when the celebrations took place.
b1-monarchia-02.prompt: Tell your friend what Heroes' Square was built in memory of and in which year the Millennium celebrations were held.
cues: Say the year of the celebrations
b1-monarchia-02.target: A Hősök terét a honfoglalás ezeréves évfordulójának emlékére építették. A millenniumi ünnepségeket 1896-ban tartották.
b1-monarchia-02.english: Heroes' Square was built in memory of the thousandth anniversary of the Conquest. The Millennium celebrations were held in 1896.
b1-monarchia-02.canDo: I can say what the Millennium of 1896 commemorated and what was built for it.

b1-monarchia-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Coffeehouses of Budapest
b1-monarchia-03.scenario: A guest in a Budapest coffeehouse asks you, a learner preparing for the citizenship interview, what the city was like around 1900.
b1-monarchia-03.prompt: Tell the guest what the coffeehouses were and how Budapest changed within a few decades.
cues: Say what role the coffeehouses had
Say how the city changed in a few decades
b1-monarchia-03.target: A kávéházak a budapesti polgárosodás fontos központjai voltak. Néhány évtized alatt Budapest átalakult nagyvárossá.
b1-monarchia-03.english: The coffeehouses were important centres of Budapest's bourgeois development. Within a few decades Budapest was transformed into a large city.
b1-monarchia-03.canDo: I can say how Budapest grew into a large city between 1873 and 1910.

b1-monarchia-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Industry in Budapest
b1-monarchia-04.scenario: A museum guide at an exhibition about the Ganz works asks you what made Budapest's industry famous.
b1-monarchia-04.prompt: Tell the guide what role the milling industry played and what the Ganz engineers developed.
cues: Say what role the milling industry played
Say what the Ganz engineers developed
b1-monarchia-04.target: A budapesti malomipar világviszonylatban is vezető szerepet töltött be. A Ganz gyárban kifejlesztették a zárt vasmagú transzformátort.
b1-monarchia-04.english: The Budapest milling industry played a leading role even in global terms. In the Ganz factory they developed the closed-core transformer.
b1-monarchia-04.canDo: I can say why Budapest's milling and engineering industries were famous.

b1-monarchia-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Happy Peacetime
b1-monarchia-05.scenario: At the citizenship interview the examiner asks you about the "happy peacetime" before 1914.
b1-monarchia-05.prompt: Tell the examiner that the capital grew rich while many poor people emigrated to America.
cues: Say what happened in the capital
Say what many poor people did
b1-monarchia-05.target: Miközben a főváros gazdagodott, sok szegény ember kivándorolt Amerikába.
b1-monarchia-05.english: While the capital grew rich, many poor people emigrated to America.
b1-monarchia-05.canDo: I can say what the Happy Peacetime was and which tensions lay under it.

b1-monarchia-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Austria-Hungary in Review
b1-monarchia-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the unit your teacher asks you for a short summary of the Monarchy for the citizenship interview.
b1-monarchia-consolidation.prompt: Tell the teacher which affairs were common in the Monarchy and what happened to it in 1918.
cues: Say what happened to the Monarchy in 1918
b1-monarchia-consolidation.target: A Monarchiában a hadsereg és a külpolitika közös volt. A Monarchia 1918-ban felbomlott.
b1-monarchia-consolidation.english: In the Monarchy the army and foreign policy were common. The Monarchy dissolved in 1918.
b1-monarchia-consolidation.canDo: I can review the people, places and events of Austria-Hungary between 1867 and 1918.
